mainImage.alt: Interior of the U.S. House of Representatives chamber during a floor vote on Israel aid, showing the electronic voting board and members at their desks
mainImage.caption: The U.S. House of Representatives votes on Israel's $3.3 billion annual security aid package on the House floor in Washington, D.C.

body.caption: Protesters gather on Capitol Hill calling for a ceasefire in the Middle East as AIPAC targets candidates who support conditioning aid to Israel. Grassroots pressure has fundamentally reshaped Democratic Party politics on the question of U.S. support for Israel’s military.

body.alt: Benjamin Netanyahu speaking from a podium at the AIPAC policy conference before a large audience with Israeli and American flags on stage
body.caption: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu addresses the annual AIPAC policy conference in Washington, D.C. AIPAC has poured over $100 million into U.S. elections to maintain uncritical support for Israel.

body.alt: Crowd of protesters gathered outside the U.S. Capitol holding signs demanding a ceasefire in Gaza, with the Capitol dome visible in the background
body.caption: Protesters rally outside the Capitol demanding a ceasefire in Gaza as Democratic lawmakers face mounting pressure from their base over U.S. support for Israel’s military operations.
